name: AWS
tagline: Cloud APIs, CLI, SDKs, IAM, and infrastructure services.
shortDescription: AWS has extremely broad APIs, SDKs, CLI, IAM, CloudFormation, CloudTrail, and service-specific docs.
agentSummary: Powerful for agents that can operate within least-privilege IAM and infrastructure-as-code guardrails.
bestFor: Cloud provisioning, compute, storage, queues, AI services, logs, and enterprise infrastructure.
cautionNotes: Key limitations: High blast radius: IAM, billing, data deletion, networking, and production changes require strict review. Model behavior, costs, rate limits, data retention, and safety policies can change by model and account tier; use evals, spend caps, and data controls for sensitive workloads. MCP servers inherit the connected account's scopes and may send prompts or data to third-party services; configure read-only or narrow scopes when available. CLI access is powerful but can run destructive local or production commands; prefer dry runs, preview environments, and non-production credentials.
pricingSummary: Public service pricing calculators and per-service rates; complex at scale.
authModel: IAM users/roles, STS, SSO, policies, permission boundaries, and access keys.
accountCreation: Self-serve account creation with billing and identity verification.
browserSupport: Console is broad and useful but risky for unsupervised agents.

capabilities.detail: AWS CLI supports scriptable access to AWS services.
AWS services expose APIs and SDKs with service-specific references.
AWS provides managed and open-source MCP servers for AWS docs, APIs, infrastructure, databases, observability, and service-specific workflows.
Docs are extensive, service-specific, and versioned.
Public service pricing calculators and per-service rates; complex at scale.
Self-serve account creation with billing and identity verification.
Console is broad and useful but risky for unsupervised agents.
Separate accounts, IAM boundaries, and IaC plans can make agent work safer.
